title: Berkeley Housing Pipeline Database
description: Track 156 housing development projects in Berkeley, CA (115 permitted, 41 proposed/reported).
source: City of Berkeley Planning & Building Departments, Eric Gellerman's Berkeley Development Map

berkeley_housing_map.title: Berkeley Housing Pipeline
berkeley_housing_map.description: Housing projects with timeline tracking - 5,470 total units

projects.title: All Projects (156)
projects.description: Housing projects from permits and media - 5,470 total units

projects_by_media_coverage.title: Projects by Media Coverage
projects_by_media_coverage.description: Projects ranked by number of news articles
projects_by_media_coverage.sql: SELECT p.address_display, p.data_source, p.net_units, COUNT(n.url) as article_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT n.source) as sources FROM projects p LEFT JOIN news_coverage n ON p.id = n.project_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY article_count DESC

proposed_vs_permitted.title: Proposed vs Permitted
proposed_vs_permitted.sql: SELECT data_source, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(net_units) as total_units FROM projects GROUP BY data_source

news_by_source.title: News Articles by Source
news_by_source.description: Count of articles by news outlet
news_by_source.sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) as count FROM news_coverage GROUP BY source ORDER BY count DESC

projects_without_permits.title: Media-Reported Projects (No Permit)
projects_without_permits.description: Projects that appear in news but not in permit system
projects_without_permits.sql: SELECT address_display, latitude, longitude, primary_news_source FROM projects WHERE has_official_permit = 0 ORDER BY address_display
